title: Контроль якості представлення
fields_and_relations: Точна revision, очікуване/фактичне, технічні виміри, докази та outcome.

implementation.view_model: Result queue; wizard with byte checksums, structural/parameter measurements, per-file review/evidence, exact revision QC, known-defect acceptance, linked recapture tasks, report export and preservation/reconciliation navigation.
limitations: PNG/JPEG/WAV basic parsers and browser opening probes; no exhaustive codec or conservation analysis.
Unsupported and unmeasured parameters require an evidenced external review; browser probing does not prove playback of the entire recording.
No acceptance without expected capture plan; no change of access rights or publication.
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; preserves old QC and original files.
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
